hazards.name: Construction Obstruction
hazards.description: Active construction work and equipment are blocking the sidewalk and creating uneven, unpaved surfaces for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and middle ground on the left side of the roadway.

hazards.name: Excessive crossing distance
hazards.description: The wide multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to cross a significant distance without any refuge or marked protection.
hazards.location_in_image: Spanning the entire width of the roadway in the center of the frame

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a significant duration without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Construction Activity
hazards.description: Traffic cones and barrels on the roadway edge may create confusion or narrow the available space for pedestrians and vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right sides of the foreground intersection

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: A large trash receptacle and utility poles are positioned within the wide sidewalk area, which could impede the path of travel for those with visual or mobility impairments.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and left foreground on the sidewalk.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: No physical barrier or planting strip exists between the sidewalk and the roadway, exposing pedestrians to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line throughout the visible block

hazards.name: Wide multi-lane roadway
hazards.description: The four-lane configuration encourages higher vehicle speeds and creates a long, unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Construction zone obstructions
hazards.description: Orange barrels and construction barriers on the right side of the street clutter the pedestrian environment and may narrow the usable walkway.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no visible crosswalks or pedestrian signals in this long block, which may lead to unsafe mid-block crossing attempts.

hazards.name: Construction Zone Hazards
hazards.description: Temporary barriers and uneven pavement in the median area create tripping hazards and visual clutter.
hazards.location_in_image: Center median area with orange and white pylons

hazards.name: Unprotected Construction Zone
hazards.description: Active construction on the left side lacks physical barriers, forcing workers and potentially pedestrians into the roadway.

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parallel parked cars on the right side create visual barriers between pedestrians on the sidewalk and approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Vehicle Access Point
hazards.description: A wide roll-down gate indicates a driveway crossing the sidewalk, creating a conflict point between vehicles and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image at the Golden Dragon storefront

hazards.name: Lack of sidewalk buffer
hazards.description: Pedestrians on the left sidewalk are directly adjacent to moving traffic with no physical separation like trees or parked cars.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossing
hazards.description: There is no designated crossing point for pedestrians accessing the dental school from the other side of the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Mid-block in front of the school

hazards.name: Undefined pedestrian path
hazards.description: The near side of the street consists of gravel and construction delineators without a clear, paved sidewalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and near side of the road

hazards.name: Unpaved sidewalk gap
hazards.description: A large rectangular section of missing pavement near the curb creates a significant tripping hazard and an uneven surface for mobility devices.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the sidewalk near the curb

hazards.name: Lack of mid-block crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crossings visible along this long stretch of commercial frontage, which may lead to unsafe mid-block crossings.

hazards.name: Wide crossing distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane roadway requires a long unprotected crossing distance, increasing exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the far curb block sight lines between pedestrians and drivers.

hazards.name: Wide Roadway
hazards.description: The multi-lane configuration encourages higher vehicle speeds and increases the distance pedestrians must cross unprotected.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the left side of the street can obscure pedestrians attempting to cross from the sidewalk.

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Design
hazards.description: The wide, straight configuration of the arterial lanes encourages higher vehicle speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb near the crosswalk may block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians entering the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the far curb

hazards.name: Lack of Mid-block Crossings
hazards.description: No marked pedestrian crossings are visible along this long stretch of commercial frontage, which may lead to unsafe mid-block crossing attempts.

hazards.name: Lack of physical buffer
hazards.description: There is no continuous physical barrier or buffer zone between the wide sidewalk and the moving traffic lane.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parking
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the right curb may obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.

hazards.name: High-speed road design
hazards.description: Wide, straight travel lanes with minimal traffic calming encourage higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Unmarked Driveway Crossing
hazards.description: A wide entrance to a parking lot crosses the sidewalk without clear markings or priority for pedestrians, creating a vehicle conflict zone.
hazards.location_in_image: Middle ground, right of the main building.

hazards.name: Metal Grates on Sidewalk
hazards.description: Large metal utility grates integrated into the sidewalk can be slippery when wet or present a trip hazard.

interventions.title: Midblock Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island to reduce crossing distance and improve safety.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions at future crossing points to increase pedestrian visibility and shorten the exposure time in the roadway.

interventions.title: Construction Zone Management
interventions.description: Ensure a clear, ADA-compliant path of travel is maintained around the construction barriers on the right sidewalk.
interventions.source: Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices (MUTCD)

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island at the intersection to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in stages.

interventions.title: Temporary Pedestrian Access Route
interventions.description: Ensure a clear, paved, and ADA-compliant temporary path is maintained through the construction zone.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light to reduce conflicts with turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Street Furniture Management
interventions.description: Relocate the trash receptacle and ensure utility poles are placed in a consistent 'furniture zone' to maintain a clear, straight through-zone for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Install street trees or large planters along the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and vehicular traffic.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Implement a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island to provide a safe crossing point on this wide street.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Add a buffer of street trees or planters between the wide sidewalk and the travel lanes to provide physical separation and slow traffic through psychological narrowing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island Improvement
interventions.description: Complete the construction of a permanent, raised refuge island with high-visibility bollards to provide a safe waiting area mid-crossing.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install continental-style high-visibility crosswalk markings to improve driver awareness of the crossing point.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Activated Signal
interventions.description: Install a Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (RRFB) or HAWK signal to alert drivers to pedestrians attempting to cross this wide arterial.

interventions.title: Temporary Pedestrian Barriers
interventions.description: Deploy physical barriers like water-filled K-rails to separate the construction zone and any temporary walkway from active traffic lanes.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Upgrade intersection crossings with high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness of pedestrian zones.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Install street trees or large planters along the curb to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Driveway Markings
interventions.description: Use contrasting pavement materials or paint to clearly define the vehicle crossing area at the roll-down gate.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes to slow traffic and provide space for a dedicated bike lane or wider sidewalk buffers.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a marked crossing with a central refuge island to break up the long crossing distance across multiple lanes.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk to provide a legal and safer crossing point for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly designate pedestrian priority areas.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Infill
interventions.description: Pave the missing section of the sidewalk to ensure a continuous, level, and ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add lighting fixtures specifically designed to illuminate the walkway to improve visibility and security during evening hours.

interventions.title: High-visibility mid-block crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and signage to provide a safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crosswalk with RRFB
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk equipped with Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB) to alert drivers to pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Designate a portion of the wide sidewalk for street furniture, such as benches or bike racks, to create a functional barrier and enhance the public realm.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce travel lane widths to naturally slow traffic speeds and reclaim space for pedestrian or transit infrastructure.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon (HAWK)
interventions.description: Install a pedestrian-activated signal to facilitate safe crossings across the multi-lane arterial.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-activated flashing lights to alert drivers to the presence of people in the midblock crosswalk.

interventions.title: Install Street Furniture and Planters
interventions.description: Adding benches, permanent trash receptacles, and continuous planting strips would create a more comfortable buffer for pedestrians and improve the streetscape.

interventions.title: Raised Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Replace the painted median and flexible bollards with a raised concrete island to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Driveway Marking
interventions.description: Clearly mark the sidewalk path across the parking lot entrance with high-visibility paint or different paving materials to assert pedestrian priority.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer
interventions.description: Install a furniture zone or planting strip between the sidewalk and the roadway to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Plant street trees to provide shade, improve the aesthetic environment, and naturally slow traffic through vertical framing.
